title: Deque Malfunction
statement: The task gives m arriving values from 1..n (1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 2·10^5). Each value must be pushed to the front or back of a deque, or inserted anywhere at the cost of one malfunction, and elements may be popped from either end at any time. The goal is to finish with exactly [1..n] using the fewest malfunctions, or report -1 if that is impossible.
